overview: One of the world's oldest living cities: ghats along the Ganga, the evening aarti, dawn boat rides and nearby Sarnath where the Buddha gave his first sermon.
fit: Meaningful for the 10-year-old; busy, crowded lanes need care with the 4-year-old.
season: November–February is cool (8–25°C); fog on winter mornings. Dev Deepawali (Kartik Purnima, Nov) lights up the ghats but is very crowded. Summer is very hot; monsoon floods the ghats.
gettingAround: Autos and e-rickshaws; the old city is on foot.

foodTips: Very vegetarian-friendly. Choose busy, clean places.
save: Share a boat with another family
safety: Very crowded lanes; hold hands and keep the 4-year-old in a carrier
Cremation ghats may upset the kids; prepare them or avoid Manikarnika
Watch out for cows and bikes in lanes
kids: Talk about the Lion Capital on our coins before Sarnath
Make the boat ride a highlight
